targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM website_event WHERE website_id = 'a78a37e2-e48d-4971-8970-ccd48af3c1dc'::uuid AND event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM website_event WHERE website_id = 'a78a37e2-e48d-4971-8970-ccd48af3c1dc'::uuid AND event_name = 'extension-download' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM website_event WHERE website_id = 'a78a37e2-e48d-4971-8970-ccd48af3c1dc'::uuid AND event_name = 'extension-submit' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM website_event WHERE website_id = 'a78a37e2-e48d-4971-8970-ccd48af3c1dc'::uuid AND event_name = 'extension-review' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'extension-download') AS downloads, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'extension-submit') AS submissions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'extension-review') AS reviews FROM website_event WHERE website_id = 'a78a37e2-e48d-4971-8970-ccd48af3c1dc'::uuid AND event_type = 2 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT url_path AS bundle, count(*) AS downloads, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS distinct_sessions FROM website_event WHERE website_id = 'a78a37e2-e48d-4971-8970-ccd48af3c1dc'::uuid AND event_name = 'extension-download' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY url_path ORDER BY downloads DESC LIMIT 25

WITH s AS (SELECT we.event_id, we.created_at, max(CASE WHEN ed.data_key = 'slug' THEN ed.string_value END) AS slug, max(CASE WHEN ed.data_key = 'version' THEN ed.string_value END) AS version, max(CASE WHEN ed.data_key = 'type' THEN ed.string_value END) AS type, max(CASE WHEN ed.data_key = 'submissionType' THEN ed.string_value END) AS submission_type FROM website_event we LEFT JOIN event_data ed ON ed.website_event_id = we.event_id WHERE we.website_id = 'a78a37e2-e48d-4971-8970-ccd48af3c1dc'::uuid AND we.event_name = 'extension-submit' AND $__timeFilter(we.created_at) GROUP BY we.event_id, we.created_at) SELECT created_at, slug, version, type, submission_type FROM s ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT ed.string_value AS action, count(*) AS reviews FROM website_event we JOIN event_data ed ON ed.website_event_id = we.event_id WHERE we.website_id = 'a78a37e2-e48d-4971-8970-ccd48af3c1dc'::uuid AND we.event_name = 'extension-review' AND ed.data_key = 'action' AND $__timeFilter(we.created_at) GROUP BY ed.string_value

WITH r AS (SELECT we.event_id, we.created_at, max(CASE WHEN ed.data_key = 'action' THEN ed.string_value END) AS action, max(CASE WHEN ed.data_key = 'slug' THEN ed.string_value END) AS slug, max(CASE WHEN ed.data_key = 'version' THEN ed.string_value END) AS version FROM website_event we LEFT JOIN event_data ed ON ed.website_event_id = we.event_id WHERE we.website_id = 'a78a37e2-e48d-4971-8970-ccd48af3c1dc'::uuid AND we.event_name = 'extension-review' AND $__timeFilter(we.created_at) GROUP BY we.event_id, we.created_at) SELECT created_at, action, slug, version FROM r ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
